part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in `getrangeCommand` (src/object.c:818): when a negative `end` remained negative after conversion (i.e., pointed before the string start), it was clamped to `0`, so `SUBSTR key 0 -500` became `0..0` and returned the first character instead of an empty string.

The fix returns `emptybulk` when the converted `end` is still negative. Verified:
- The issue's repro now returns `""` for both `substr test 1 -500` and `substr test 0 -500`
- `unit/type/string` (includes the new `getrange`/`substr` end<start cases): all pass
- `unit/hyperloglog` and `unit/bitops`: all pass
